mappings.book: Generative AI Prompt Engineering Learning Ecosystem
mappings.concept_or_chapter: Feedback loops and learning from repeated real work
mappings.connection: A persistent assistant creates a continuous learning surface: goals, outcomes, corrections, and recurring routines become material for improving how people delegate work.
mappings.what_to_study_next: How to design feedback loops that improve a recurring AI workflow without silently broadening authority.

mappings.book: Generative AI Professional Prompt Engineering Guide
mappings.concept_or_chapter: Reusable instructions, tool contracts, and bounded specialist behavior
mappings.connection: The AWS skill turns domain instructions and operating constraints into a reusable capability package that a compatible assistant can load rather than rebuilding expertise in every prompt.
mappings.what_to_study_next: How to separate durable skill instructions from task-specific prompts and require explicit confirmation before consequential actions.

mappings.concept_or_chapter: Acceptance criteria, evaluation, and human oversight
mappings.connection: The Ironclad work converts complex professional work into measurable tasks with explicit requirements, making reliability visible at the workflow level.
mappings.what_to_study_next: How to write task-level acceptance criteria that measure whether an AI system preserved business rules, not just whether it produced an output.

mappings.concept_or_chapter: Permission-aware organizational context and source-of-truth grounding
mappings.connection: Enterprise AI becomes more reliable when it can resolve the right project, owner, decision, permission, and source of truth instead of reasoning over a flat pile of documents.
mappings.what_to_study_next: How to construct context layers that preserve identity, permissions, provenance, and recency across enterprise systems.

mappings.concept_or_chapter: Retrieval architecture, embedding design, and context locality
mappings.connection: A unified local embedding space changes where retrieval happens and can reduce intermediate transformations that otherwise add latency and context loss.
mappings.what_to_study_next: How modality choice, local indexes, and retrieval thresholds affect the context delivered to downstream AI systems.

mappings.concept_or_chapter: System-level reliability, latency budgets, and operational performance
mappings.connection: A capable AI workflow can still fail the user experience if repeated inference cycles exceed the latency budget. Reliability includes predictable wall time as well as output quality.
mappings.what_to_study_next: How to define end-to-end latency budgets across reasoning, generation, tool execution, verification, and retries.
